name: XPRS 1.13.0-beta.2
body:
## XPRS 1.13.0-beta.2

Fixes found testing beta.1 on a phone against a station.

### Files
- A fetch asks the station named as holder for its own record first, so the piece list is known at once and a large file comes in pieces. In beta.1 a phone waited 30 seconds and then took the whole file from one holder.
- A fetch started in a device's first seconds, before it has a Reticulum route to the holder, tries again (after 1, 2 and 4 minutes) instead of failing once and waiting out its time.

### Settings
- The device row shows the name you transmit as.

### Known limits
- Across a public hub a holder's acceptance can arrive after the fetch has already started on the whole file, so pieces are not used there yet.
- A fresh install can wait up to an hour to hear an archiver on a public hub, and its public groups list can stay empty; under investigation.
